## Independence and basis

Same separate nonauthor delivery assessor reviewed the unchanged complete plan against fresh exact thirteen-member design-review-r6. Parent authored the plan/models; reviewer authored none. This is a distinct Delivery assessment, not a Design judgment substituted for Delivery or an old approval retargeted to changed upstream bytes. The complete original Delivery assessment and retained-policy correction remain history in delivery-review/delivery-review-r2. Plan identity is unchanged; existing full-plan reading and derivation assessment remain applicable, with this renewal inspecting M4/TG-07, final integrated proof, consumer scope and current Design source map explicitly.

Current Design changes are scoped ownership/navigation and historical labeling that implement already approved displacement, not new runtime behavior. Original Distribution/System/proposal contracts remain unchanged. The additional exact Workflow, mixed architecture and CLI dependency members add visible consumers to the review package; they do not add a new implementation milestone or unallocated behavior. Fresh r6 records legacy format classification: five grandfathered retained specs, and published-skill-first's separately retained boundary/proof requirements. No plan reauthoring or lifecycle-state backfill is needed.

## Readiness and verification adequacy

Dependency order remains safe: M1 proves bounded force primitives before M2 public integration; M2 aligns producer/installer/release target inventories before M3 removes obsolete mirror production/proof; M4 retires exact sources only after necessary behavior/protection and independent milestone review. Corrections remain required before reliance. M4 expressly includes current owner-model links, mixed architecture sections, governance and consumer navigation and sends unexpected source/behavior scope to Design. Therefore the actual nav/ownership edits fit the already reviewed M4 boundary rather than silently expanding it.

Traceability remains requirement -> owner boundary -> milestone -> proof -> command. DIST-SR-01/19/20 and DES-SR-13/21/SYS composition map to M4/TG-07: exact fifteen-file map, accessible replacement meaning, current reader reconciliation and historical identity preservation. C7 executes boundary/lifecycle readers, C8 selects actual checks using every intended changed/deleted path, C9 validates exact model/legacy bodies with independent classification, and C10 separates model/plan enforcement from disclosed legacy audit debt. The unchanged M4 evidence text explicitly says link replacement alone does not prove a reader stopped opening deleted sources. No missing operational-reader proof is deferred to successful Verify by this assessment.

Normal and negative installation, trust, unsafe path, partial failure/retry, capabilities and state preservation remain allocated to M1/M2 and TG-FINAL-01, with actual generated/packed/release composition through C2/C3/C4/C8. This renewal introduces no new installer or release boundary requiring different tests. The real filesystem corrections found during M3 implement already allocated runtime-preservation outcomes; independent correction review remains separate evidence, not a reason to rewrite Design or the stable plan.

Retirement safety remains explicit. TG-08 E1 names owners/failure protection/triggers/repair/retirement basis; E2 requires actual representative old/replacement proof before deleting checks; E3 records four actual measurements and comparison limits with no savings threshold. The separately adopted notices in published-skill-first do not waive this initiative's allocated R14/R19/R22 requirements. Navigation source retirement in M4 is not permission to delete historical operational fixtures or original review/report identities.

Intermediate states and recovery remain reviewable: old sources stay readable until replacement behavior/proof is reviewed; exact selected sources/consumers can be restored together if obligations are lost; unknown consumers stop affected removal. Existing historical observations remain historical. Conditional governance adoption and FU-013 disposition require successful Verify, not completion of link edits. The plan's no extra validator/selector/cache budget is unchanged.

Final integrated assessment is separately allocated. TG-FINAL-01 composes actual two-target archive/metadata/packed path and selective evidence reuse by exact unaffected basis; TG-FINAL-02 reconciles source ownership/history and actual E1–E3 proof. Fresh independent whole-change Code Review follows all milestones/corrections and precedes distinct Verify. Neither passing C7/C8 nor milestone review substitutes for that checkpoint. M4 current code-review/proof is still outstanding at this Delivery assessment, and this record does not claim it complete.

## Evidence and claim limits

No runtime tests were run for this unchanged-plan renewal; execution checks remain the implementation/Code Review/Verify responsibility. The known legacy prose observations and authored C9 reports are not converted to a full-file success or proof of implementation. The review evaluates whether the existing commands, actual reader audit, historical identity checks and independent classification can establish the required outcomes against the current exact Design package; they can. Existing approved plan identity and fresh Design review are included in required reads so concurrent subject changes reject recording.

No allocation finding exists. Return approval to Route for remaining authorized M4 and final closeout gates. Preserve prior judgments/subjects as history. This Delivery renewal grants no publication, push, adoption or final-readiness authority.
